title: Skill
description: An on-demand capability pack — procedures/knowledge, optionally with bundled scripts (skills profile). Carries provenance (D1) and an execution requirement (I7). Normative.

source.description: Opaque host-defined provenance pointer (marketplace ref, path, url).

kind.description: Provenance class. builtin/local are first-party; imported is untrusted-by-default (Capabilities §5).

signature.description: RESERVED, forward-compatible. Unverified in 0.3 — a variant MAY verify it later without a breaking change. Absence/null ⇒ unsigned.

kind.description: instruction-only = fully portable; script = requires the capabilities in `requires` (I7).

requires.description: Capabilities the skill's scripts need (e.g. "shell"). A variant lacking one marks the skill not-runnable-here.
